# ACFE 부정 유형과 패턴

부정 패턴(P-001 ~ P-032)의 ACFE(공인부정조사사협회) 부정 유형을 모은 표다. 시나리오 답변의 「근거: ACFE …」에 이 유형을 그대로 쓴다. 조합 시나리오는 조합에 든 패턴의 ACFE 유형을 모두 적는다(같은 유형은 한 번).

- 종류: 업계 기준(부정 분류)
- 관련 패턴: 아래 표

| ACFE 유형 | 패턴 |
|---|---|
| Revenue Recognition Fraud, Rebate Fraud | P-001 |
| Cash Disbursements Fraud (Slush Fund, Promotional Fund Manipulation) | P-002 |
| Vendor Overbilling (Fake Vendor, Shell Company Registration) | P-003 |
| Expense Reimbursement Fraud (Forged Receipts, Duplicate Invoices), Vendor Overbilling, Technical Service Overbilling | P-004 |
| Inventory Theft (Employee Discount Abuse, Unauthorized Resale), B2B → B2C 유출 | P-005 |
| Wire Transfer Fraud (Payment Diversion, Bank Account Manipulation) | P-006 |
| Conflict of Interest (Self-Dealing, Undisclosed Relationships) | P-007 |
| Cash Disbursements Fraud (Return PO Abuse, System Control Bypass) | P-008 |
| Expense Reimbursement Fraud (Budget Misuse, Cross-Charging) | P-009 |
| Negligence (Failure to Verify, Oversight) | P-010 |
| Digital Asset Misuse (Account Sharing, Credential Theft) | P-011 |
| Customer Refund Fraud (Warranty Abuse, Service System Exploitation) | P-012 |
| Revenue Recognition Fraud (Fake Production Records), Inventory Fraud (Quality Data Manipulation) | P-013 |
| Vendor Overbilling (Bid Rigging, Price Manipulation) | P-014 |
| Intellectual Property Theft (R&D IP Misappropriation) | P-015 |
| Inventory Fraud (Fake Shipping, Inventory Manipulation) | P-016 |
| Customer Refund Fraud (Warranty Parts Abuse, Service Cost Inflation) | P-017 |
| Expense Reimbursement Fraud, Vendor Overbilling, Payroll Fraud, Cash Disbursements Fraud | P-018 |
| Skimming (1-1) | P-019 |
| Payroll Fraud (1-1), Ghost Promoter Fraud (1-1) | P-020 |
| Inventory Fraud (1-2) | P-021 |
| Counterfeit Parts (1-2) | P-022 |
| Asset Disposal Fraud (1-4) | P-023 |
| Undisclosed Conflicts (2) | P-024 |
| Extortion (2) | P-025 |
| Revenue Recognition Fraud (3) | P-026, P-027, P-028 |
| Period End Manipulation (3) | P-029 |
| Customer Refund Fraud (1-1) | P-030 |
| Check Tampering (1-1) | P-031 |
| Petty Cash Fraud (1-1) | P-032 |
